replacements.name: split-x-then-y
replacements.text:
chain_position.x = creature->target_offset.x + pos->x;                                                             \
        chain_position.y = creature->target_offset.y + pos->y;                                                             \
        *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = chain_position;                                                    \

replacements.name: split-y-then-x
replacements.text:
chain_position.y = creature->target_offset.y + pos->y;                                                             \
        chain_position.x = creature->target_offset.x + pos->x;                                                             \
        *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = chain_position;                                                    \

replacements.name: copy-target-then-add
replacements.text:
chain_position = *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->target_offset;                                               \
        chain_position.x = chain_position.x + pos->x;                                                                      \
        chain_position.y = chain_position.y + pos->y;                                                                      \
        *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = chain_position;                                                    \

replacements.name: copy-target-compound-add
replacements.text:
chain_position = *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->target_offset;                                               \
        chain_position.x += pos->x;                                                                                        \
        chain_position.y += pos->y;                                                                                        \
        *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = chain_position;                                                    \

replacements.name: scalar-destination
replacements.text:
creature->position.x = creature->target_offset.x + pos->x;                                                         \
        creature->position.y = creature->target_offset.y + pos->y;                                                         \

replacements.name: named-scalars
replacements.text:
float child_position_x = creature->target_offset.x + pos->x;                                                       \
        float child_position_y = creature->target_offset.y + pos->y;                                                       \
        chain_position.set(child_position_x, child_position_y);                                                            \
        *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = chain_position;                                                    \

replacements.name: position-copy-then-add
replacements.text:
*(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->position = *(creature_spawn_vec2_t *)&creature->target_offset;               \
        creature->position.x = creature->position.x + pos->x;                                                              \
        creature->position.y = creature->position.y + pos->y;                                                              \
